drivingQuestion: What is the difference between the first tanna and R' Shimon?
outcomeNote: First answer given; elaborated with alternatives in the next unit.

segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן: אֲנִי רָאִיתִי גְּדִיָּיה כּוּ׳. מַאי אִיכָּא בֵּין תַּנָּא קַמָּא לְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן? אִיכָּא בֵּינַיְיהוּ דִּזְעֵירִי.
segments.en: § The baraita teaches that «Rabbi Shimon says: I saw» a single «kid» that yielded enough offspring to be subject to the tithe within its first year of life. By contrast, the first tanna in the baraita does not add the phrase: Within its first year of life. The Gemara asks: «What» difference «is there between» the opinion of «the first tanna and» that of «Rabbi Shimon?» The Gemara answers that there is a difference «between» them in a case where the second-generation goats expel a murky discharge on the first day of their seventh month, which is the seventh month of their year for animal tithe. And they disagree with regard to the statement «of Ze’eiri,» cited earlier, that the expulsion of a discharge which exempts an animal from having its future offspring counted a firstborn is one which prevents it from being impregnated for no less than thirty days.
